name: Shiraz Persian Cuisine
crossCheckedAgainst: https://shirazinc.com/san-diego-rancho-bernardo-shiraz-persian-cuisine-food-menu (restaurant's own SpotHopper-powered site; address 12125 Alta Carmel Court matches exactly)
notes: The restaurant's own site (shirazinc.com, a SpotHopper spot_id=396693 ordering widget rendered server-side) prints odd-cent prices sitewide (Dinner menu $8.31, $36.39, $41.59 etc; Drink menu $8.31, $15.59/Glass etc) that divide cleanly by 1.04 onto round .99/.50 values with almost no exceptions -- the same 4%-online-surcharge signature the playbook has caught before on other SpotHopper/Clover storefronts. Per the never-construct-a-price rule, those divided figures were NOT used. Instead, DoorDash's own listing for the same address (verified exact address match) publishes the same dishes at clean, human-set .99 prices that match the shirazinc.com figures divided by 1.04 to the cent (e.g. Hummus: site $10.39 / 1.04 = $9.99 = DoorDash's $9.99; Mast-o Khiar: site $8.31 / 1.04 = $7.99 = DoorDash's $7.99) -- so DoorDash's own prices, not a computed figure, were used as the source, with the site cited only as the cross-check that explains and confirms them. DoorDash covers all core sections (Appetizer, Soup & Salads, Main Dishes/Kababs/Stews/Rice, Daily Specials, Dessert, non-alcoholic Drinks) but is missing several items present on the restaurant's own site: Cornish Hen Kabab, Grilled Vegetable Kabab, Dizi (Abgoosht), Aush-e Reshteh (Seasonal), Looti Polo, Albaloo Polo & Chicken or Beef, Ghafghazi Salad, Zereshk Polo (standalone), Olives, French Fries, and Ghormeh Sabzi (Vegetarian) -- all omitted from this capture since no clean-priced source carries them. The separate weekday Lunch Menu (11am-3pm, 15 items) on shirazinc.com is NOT subject to the 4% pattern (its own already-round .99 prices do not divide cleanly by 1.04 either) and was used directly, tagged '(Lunch)' where the dish name would otherwise collide with a dinner item at a different price. The Beer/Wine/Bottles list on the site's separate drink-menu page shows the same 1.04 pattern with no second source found, so it was excluded entirely (not guessed). Confidence capped at medium per the source ladder for a delivery marketplace even though it passed the markup check and the cross-check confirms it precisely.

DoorDash's listing for '9872 Hibert St Ste D1, San Diego' (work-list address is '9870 Hibert Street #D-1' -- a 2-digit street-number mismatch, but the suite number, city and the chain's own poke.house/locations/poke-miramesa-sandiego page match exactly, so treated as the same store) carries a complete 5-section menu -- Signature Bowls (7), Build Your Own (4), Sides (6), Hand Rolls (6), Drinks (9), 32 items -- with prices that don't divide cleanly by any of 1.04/1.1/1.15/1.2/1.25/1.3, so no markup pattern was detected. Grubhub's listing for the same address (grubhub.com/restaurant/poke-house-san-diego-9872-hibert-street-san-diego/8979728) is a client-rendered shell with no prices in static HTML, so no second independent cross-check source was reachable; confidence is capped at medium per the source ladder for a single marketplace listing.

dishes.name: Tuna Lover Bowl
dishes.description: Craving tuna? This tuna packed bowl combines our three tuna offerings—ahi tuna, spicy tuna, and garlic oyster tuna—to satisfy your craving. Includes cucumber, white and green onions, masago, and furikake with a blend of sesame oil, house shoyu and citrus ponzu sauce. Served over rice or salad with seaweed salad and crab salad.

dishes.name: Miso Salmon Bowl
dishes.description: A sweet and savory salmon bowl featuring our fresh Scottish salmon combined with grape tomatoes, edamame, cucumber, white and green onions, hijiki seaweed, and masago over rice or salad. Mixed with a blend of sesame oil, miso aioli, sweet unagi, and finished off with furikake. Served with crab salad and seaweed salad.

dishes.name: House Salmon Bowl
dishes.description: A Poke House favorite since day one! Combines melt-in-your mouth Scottish salmon with a mix of masago, edamame, cucumber, white and green onions, furikake, sesame oil, citrus ponzu and our house-made sriracha aioli for a mild kick. Served over rice or salad with seaweed salad and crab salad.

dishes.name: Crispy Shoyu Chicken Bowl
dishes.description: Features our delicious oven-baked crispy shoyu chicken with rice, imitation krab salad, a bed of mixed greens, cucumbers, grape tomatoes, green onions, furikake, and topped with our house-made sriracha aioli and unagi sauce.

dishes.name: Charred Salmon Bowl
dishes.description: A warm offering featuring our spicy miso salmon lightly torched upon order. Served with torched spicy miso salmon (raw), crab salad, corn, cucumber, green onions, and masago, finished with citrus ponzu sauce, sweet unagi sauce, crispy onions, and togarashi over warm sushi rice. Please note that the Charred Salmon Bowl, contains raw fish. This product cannot be further cooked.

dishes.name: Kid's Krab Bowl
dishes.description: Two scoops of crab salad served with seaweed salad, sliced avocado, cucumbers, and green onions over your choice of base and finished with furikake and a sweet unagi sauce. No add ons please.

dishes.name: Roasted Miso Chicken Bowl
dishes.description: Our savory roasted miso chicken served over sushi rice with imitation krab salad, a bed of mixed greens, cucumbers, grape tomatoes, green onions, furikake, Unagi sauce and miso aioli.

dishes.name: Large Build Your Own (4 Scoops)
dishes.description: Our biggest portion if you're feeling hungry! Includes 4 protein scoops, imitation krab salad, and your choice of mix-ins, sauces, and toppings over rice or veggies.

dishes.name: Medium Build Your Own (3 Scoops)
dishes.description: Our most popular option! Includes 3 protein scoops, imitation krab salad, and your choice of mix-ins, sauces, and toppings over rice or veggies.

dishes.name: Small Build Your Own (2 Scoops)
dishes.description: Looking for something light? Includes 2 protein scoops, imitation krab salad, and your choice of mix-ins, sauces, and toppings over rice or veggies.

dishes.name: Veggie Bowl
dishes.description: Choose 4 mix-ins combined with sauces, and toppings over rice or veggies.

dishes.name: Miso Soup
dishes.description: Our made-to-order classic miso soup includes fresh tofu, green onions and seaweed.

dishes.name: Miso Soup and Rice
dishes.description: This heartwarming Japanese staple is a light offering featuring miso soup poured over rice topped with a choice of salmon or tofu. Finished with edamame, wakame and green onions.

dishes.name: Sushi Rice
dishes.description: Freshly prepared white rice seasoned with sushi vinegar to achieve its signature sticky texture and sweet, tangy flavor.

dishes.name: Seaweed Salad
dishes.description: Tender seaweed in a flavorful sesame dressing with sesame seeds for an extra crunch.

dishes.name: Brown Rice
dishes.description: Freshly prepared whole grain rice that is less processed than white rice features a mild, nutty flavor and a great source of dietary fiber, vitamins, and minerals.

dishes.name: 3 Hand Roll Combo
dishes.description: Can't decide? Choose any 3 hand rolls and save!

dishes.name: California Hand Roll
dishes.description: A classic made the Poke House way! Creamy crab salad rolled with cucumber, avocado, and sesame seeds.

dishes.name: Spicy Salmon Hand Roll
dishes.description: Our premium melt-in-your mouth Scottish salmon with a spicy twist rolled with, cucumbers, furikake and masago for a fresh bite!

dishes.name: Spam Musubi Hand Roll
dishes.description: Our version of the classic Hawaiian snack. Includes freshly seared Spam rolled with cucumber, furikake and unagi sauce into a savory hand roll.

dishes.name: Spicy Tuna Hand Roll
dishes.description: Our popular spicy tuna rolled with cucumber and furikake.

dishes.name: Shoyu Salmon Hand Roll
dishes.description: Our premium melt-in-your mouth Scottish salmon rolled with house shoyu, cucumbers, furikake and masago for a fresh bite!
